TSchematicPainter.Create.text: Creates a painter that draws onto a canvas through a screen transform (zoom and origin).

params.ATransform: converts design units to pixels; the painter does not own it

TSchematicPainter.Px.text: Converts a design point to a pixel position with the current transform.

TSchematicPainter.Dist.text: Converts a length in design units to pixels at the current zoom.

TSchematicPainter.Col.text: The color to draw with: the given color, or the orange selection color while drawing a selected object.

TSchematicPainter.SetPen.text: Sets the canvas pen from a color, thickness in design units and Windows dash style. The pen is at least 1 pixel wide; dashed styles only show on 1 pixel pens, as on Windows.

TSchematicPainter.Ln.text: Draws a line between two design points, including its last pixel (which LineTo leaves out).

TSchematicPainter.Poly.text: Draws a polyline, or a closed polygon with the current brush.

TSchematicPainter.SetFont.text: Selects a font resource on the canvas, scaled to the zoom (name, bold, italic, underline) in the given color with a transparent background.

params.ScreenHeight: set to the font height in pixels

TSchematicPainter.TextAt.text: Draws text anchored at a point: normal text sits above the anchor, rotated text reads upwards beside it. A backquote in the text (TinyCAD's overbar mark) is dropped.

TSchematicPainter.PaintLine.text: Draws a wire, bus or line. Objects using the default style take the sheet's wire or bus color.

TSchematicPainter.PaintJunction.text: Draws the junction dot in the junction color.

TSchematicPainter.PaintSquare.text: Draws a rectangle or ellipse with its line style and fill.

TSchematicPainter.PaintPolygon.text: Draws a polygon or arc from its flattened outline, filled when it has a fill, closed when marked closed.

TSchematicPainter.PaintText.text: Draws a text object in its box, upright or rotated.

TSchematicPainter.PaintLabel.text: Draws a wire label: its text, plus an outline for input and output labels.

TSchematicPainter.PaintPower.text: Draws a power symbol: the stem, the symbol (bar, circle, wave, arrow or earth) and its text.

TSchematicPainter.PaintPin.text: Draws a pin of a symbol: the line (with a dot or a clock triangle when set), a cross for a not-connected pin, and the pin name and number according to what is shown. Hidden pins are not drawn.

TSchematicPainter.PaintNote.text: Draws a note: its rectangle (square, rounded or none), fill and text one line per line break. Word wrapping is not done yet.

TSchematicPainter.PaintBusSlash.text: Draws a bus slash as a thick bus-colored line.

TSchematicPainter.PaintMethod.text: Draws a placed symbol: its drawing through a transform that applies its position, rotation, mirror and scale, then its reference, name and other field texts.

TSchematicPainter.PaintLadder.text: Draws ladder rails: the two rails, the bus labels above them and the line numbers beside them (thinned out when the lines are closer than the text height). When selected, outlines the rails' rectangle.

TSchematicPainter.PaintRuler.text: Draws a guide ruler as a dotted line across the sheet with its position in millimetres.

TSchematicPainter.PaintMeasure.text: Draws a measuring ruler: the line, end stops, graduations at a spacing that suits the zoom, and the distance beside the middle.

TSchematicPainter.PaintCloud.text: Draws a revision cloud: each edge of the rectangle as a row of outward semicircular scallops.

TSchematicPainter.PaintRefText.text: Draws linked text (prefix, resolved value, suffix), with a frame when selected.

TSchematicPainter.PaintObject.text: Draws any drawing object by finding its class, in the selection color when selected. Used for sheets, the placement ghost and previews.

TSchematicPainter.PaintSheet.text: Draws every object of a sheet in order, highlighting those in the selection.

TSchematicPainter.PaintPage.text: Draws the paper with its shadow, the grid dots (only when they are at least 6 pixels apart), and the border rectangle if the sheet has one.

params.Viewport: the visible pixel area, to skip dots outside it

MakeLabel.text: Creates a label on a parent control at a position.

MakeButton.text: Creates a button that closes a dialog with the given result.

params.AResult: modal result such as mrOK or mrCancel

TNewDocForm.CreateNew.text: Builds the New Document dialog in code: paper family and size lists, orientation, border and automatic sheet numbering options, and title-block fields. Starts with ISO A4 landscape selected.

TNewDocForm.FillPapers.text: Fills the size list with the papers of the chosen family (or all sizes) and selects the first.

TNewDocForm.FamilyChange.text: Event handler: the family changed, so refill the size list.

TNewDocForm.PaperIndex.text: The paper table index of the selected size (ISO A4 when nothing is selected).

TNewDocForm.Landscape.returns: True for landscape, False for portrait

TNewDocForm.PaperChange.text: Event handler: shows the selected paper's name and page size in internal units.

TNewDocForm.SelectPaper.text: Selects a paper and orientation in the dialog (used for defaults and by scripts).

TNewDocForm.BuildDesign.text: Creates the new design from the dialog's choices: one sheet with the paper size and orientation, title-block text, automatic sheet numbers, border with margin, and a first revision "A - Initial issue".
TNewDocForm.BuildDesign.returns: the new design; the caller owns it

TLadderForm.CreateFor.text: Builds the ladder properties dialog (kept for forms that still use a dialog; the ribbon now edits these properties).

TLadderForm.NumField.text: Reads a whole number from an edit box.
TLadderForm.NumField.returns: the number, or Default if the text is not a number

params.Default: value to use on bad text

TLadderForm.MmField.text: Reads a number of millimetres from an edit box (comma accepted as decimal point).
TLadderForm.MmField.returns: the number, or Default on bad text

params.Default: value to use on bad text

TLadderForm.ValuesChange.text: Event handler: shows how many lines, the spacing in mm and the numbering from the current entries.

TLadderForm.Apply.text: Copies the dialog's values into the ladder: wire numbers, first / last line, line count (at least 1), number side, rail width and rectangle.
TLadderForm.Apply.returns: False if the line numbers are not whole numbers

EditLadder.text: Shows the ladder properties dialog modally and applies it on OK.
EditLadder.returns: True if the ladder was changed

TLibraryPanel.Create.text: Builds the panel: caption, filter box, symbol list and a preview area.

TLibraryPanel.Destroy.text: Frees the preview and the open library.

TLibraryPanel.OpenLibrary.text: Opens a .TCLib library (replacing any open one) and lists its symbols. If the file cannot be opened the previous library stays and the error is raised.

TLibraryPanel.Rebuild.text: Refills the list with the symbols whose name or description contains the filter text.

TLibraryPanel.RowCount.text: Number of rows in the list.

TLibraryPanel.RowText.text: Text of one row (name and description).

TLibraryPanel.FilterChange.text: Event handler: the filter text changed, so refill the list.

TLibraryPanel.SelectRow.text: Selects a row and shows its preview.

params.Index: row number; out-of-range values are ignored

TLibraryPanel.ListClick.text: Event handler: a row was clicked, so show its preview.

TLibraryPanel.ListDblClick.text: Event handler: a row was double-clicked, so start placing that symbol.

TLibraryPanel.PlaceSelected.text: Asks the owner to start placing the selected symbol (OnPlace).

TLibraryPanel.PreviewPaint.text: Event handler: draws the selected symbol, scaled to fit, in the preview area.

Tokenize.text: Splits a script line into words on spaces; a double-quoted run counts as one word.

Num.text: Converts script text to a number using a dot as the decimal separator.

SaveForm.text: Saves a picture of a whole form as a bitmap file.

Settle.text: Lets the program process pending events (painting, timers) so the next script step sees a settled window.

RunScript.text: Runs a self-test script against the real window: each line is a command (open, tool, mouse, ribbon, setprop, undo, shot ...) that goes through the same handlers as a person's actions; results are written to standard output.

TMainForm.Create.text: Creates the main window: loads the designed form (menus, file dialogs) from mainform.lfm, makes sure it is big enough for the ribbon, and builds the layout and ribbon in code.

TMainForm.Destroy.text: Frees the property editors, detaches the view from the design and frees the design. Safe if construction failed part way.

TMainForm.BuildLayout.text: Creates the run-time controls: ribbon page control, status bar, sheet tabs, symbol library panel, splitter and the drawing view, and connects their events.

TMainForm.AddButton.text: Adds a ribbon button to a tab at the position X and moves X along for the next one.

TMainForm.AddToolButton.text: Adds a ribbon button that selects a drawing tool; it joins the group of tool buttons so one stays pressed, and its Tag holds the tool number.

TMainForm.Gap.text: Leaves a small gap between groups of ribbon buttons.

TMainForm.BuildRibbon.text: Fills the ribbon: Home (undo, redo, snap, grid size, select, delete), Draw, Ladder, Library and View buttons, the grid-size menu, and the Properties tab's scrolling editor area.

TMainForm.UpdateRibbonState.text: Brings ribbon buttons in line with the program: undo / redo enabled and their hints, snap toggle, grid size caption, and which tool button is pressed.

TMainForm.ClearPropEditors.text: Removes all property editors from the Properties tab.

HexOfColor.text: Converts a Lazarus color to RRGGBB text for properties.

ColorOfHex.text: Converts RRGGBB text to a Lazarus color.

TMainForm.RebuildProps.text: Rebuilds the Properties tab for the current selection: one editor per property the selected objects share (text box, drop-down, check box or color swatch), two per column, then fills in their values.

TMainForm.CommitProp.text: Applies a value typed or chosen in a property editor to all selected objects as one undo step, then refreshes the editors and the status line.

TMainForm.PropEditDone.text: Event handler: a text editor lost focus or Enter was pressed, so apply its text (an untouched "mixed" field is left alone).

TMainForm.PropChoiceChange.text: Event handler: a drop-down choice changed, so apply it.

TMainForm.PropBoolClick.text: Event handler: a check box was clicked, so apply 1 or 0.

TMainForm.PropColorClick.text: Event handler: a color swatch was clicked, so ask for a color and apply it.

TMainForm.SetPropertyText.text: Sets a property through the same path as typing it into its editor (used by the self-test script).
TMainForm.SetPropertyText.returns: False if the selection has no such property

TMainForm.PropertyDump.text: Lists the properties on the ribbon with their values, "(mixed)" where selected objects differ; for tests.

TMainForm.ShowRibbonTab.text: Brings a ribbon tab forward by its caption.

TMainForm.RibbonTabTitle.text: Caption of the ribbon tab showing now.

TMainForm.PressRibbon.text: Presses a ribbon button found by its caption, as if clicked (used by the self-test script).
TMainForm.PressRibbon.returns: False if no button has that caption

TMainForm.SetGridMmFromScript.text: Sets the grid size and updates the ribbon (used by the self-test script).

TMainForm.SetDesign.text: Makes a design the current document: detaches the old one, shows the new in the view, and refreshes sheet tabs, caption, paper status, ribbon and properties.

TMainForm.RebuildSheetTabs.text: Rebuilds the sheet tabs from the sheet names (or "Sheet N").

TMainForm.UpdateCaption.text: Sets the window title from the file name, a * when modified, and the application name.

TMainForm.UpdatePaperStatus.text: Shows the current sheet's paper size in the status bar.

TMainForm.ConfirmDiscard.text: Asks whether to save changes before discarding the document.

TMainForm.OpenDesignFile.text: Loads a .dsn file, gives every object an id, and makes it the current document. Errors are raised.

TMainForm.NewDesignWith.text: Creates a new document with a paper size without showing the dialog (used by scripts).

TMainForm.OpenLibraryFile.text: Opens a symbol library in the library panel.

TMainForm.InsertLadderMm.text: Adds a ladder to the current sheet from a rectangle given in millimetres, as one undo step.
TMainForm.InsertLadderMm.returns: the new ladder, or nil if no document is open

TMainForm.PlaceLibraryRow.text: Selects a library row and places the symbol with a click at a position (used by scripts).

TMainForm.DoNew.text: Menu handler: asks to save changes, shows the New Document dialog and opens a new document from it.

TMainForm.DoOpen.text: Menu handler: asks to save changes, then lets the user pick a .dsn file and opens it.

TMainForm.DoSave.text: Menu handler: saves to the current file, or asks for a name if untitled.

TMainForm.DoSaveAs.text: Menu handler: asks for a file name and saves there.

TMainForm.DoOpenLibrary.text: Menu handler: lets the user pick a .TCLib library and opens it in the library panel.

TMainForm.DoFileExit.text: Menu handler: closes the window (asking about unsaved changes).

TMainForm.DoDelete.text: Menu handler: deletes the selected objects.

TMainForm.DoSelectAll.text: Menu handler: selects everything on the sheet.

TMainForm.DoRedo.text: Handler: redoes the last undone action.

TMainForm.DoToolButton.text: Ribbon handler: starts the drawing tool whose number is in the button's Tag (or returns to select).

TMainForm.DoPlaceSymbol.text: Handler: starts placing the symbol selected in the library panel, opening a library first if none is open.

TMainForm.DoAddSheet.text: Handler: adds a sheet with the same paper, border, title block and grid as the current one, as one undo step, and shows it.

TMainForm.DoProperties.text: Menu handler: properties are on the ribbon now, so bring the Properties tab forward.

TMainForm.DoInsertLadder.text: Menu handler: starts the ladder rails tool.

TMainForm.DoRemoveSheet.text: Menu handler: removing a sheet is not implemented yet, so it says so.

TMainForm.DoToggleGrid.text: Handler: shows or hides the grid dots and ticks the menu item.

TMainForm.DoToggleSnap.text: Ribbon handler: turns snapping to the grid on or off.

TMainForm.DoGridButton.text: Ribbon handler: pops up the grid-size menu under the button with the current size ticked.

TMainForm.DoGridSize.text: Grid-size menu handler: applies the size held in the menu item's Tag (hundredths of a millimetre).

TMainForm.DoGridCustom.text: Grid-size menu handler: asks for a custom grid size in millimetres (0.05 to 100).

TMainForm.DescribeSelection.text: A short description of the selection for the status bar and ribbon (the kind of object, or "N objects").
TMainForm.DescribeSelection.returns: the description, empty when nothing is selected

TMainForm.ViewSelection.text: View event: the selection changed. Updates the status bar, rebuilds the property editors, and brings the Properties tab forward when the select tool is active.

TMainForm.ViewStatus.text: View event: shows a message in the first status panel.

TMainForm.ViewModified.text: View event: the design changed. Marks it modified, updates the caption, and refreshes the property values.

TMainForm.ViewToolChanged.text: View event: the active tool changed, so refresh the pressed tool button.

TMainForm.ViewUndoChanged.text: View event: undo state changed, so refresh the undo / redo buttons.

TMainForm.ViewPlaced.text: View event: an object was created. One-shot tools return to select; a new label brings the Properties tab forward and focuses its text box.

TMainForm.SheetTabChange.text: Event handler: another sheet tab was chosen, so show that sheet.

TMainForm.LibPlace.text: Library panel event: starts placing the chosen symbol on the current sheet.

TMainForm.FormCloseQuery.text: Event handler: allows closing only after unsaved changes have been dealt with.

params.CanClose: set False to cancel the close

TScriptCatcher.Handle.text: In script mode: prints an unhandled exception and its backtrace to the error output and ends the program, instead of showing a dialog nothing can click.
